page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening). Running head at the top, centred. Main text in one full-width column of paragraphs. No marginal notes on this page. The left-hand edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. A printer's mark or signature sits below the last line.

main_text.p: tum, Euangelista insignem concionem in coena vltima, & partim post cœnam ad discipulos habitam, quæ velut cygnea cantio fuit Christi iam morituri. In quo sermone Dominus discipulos consolatur contra scandalum suæ mortis, & contra suum ab eis discessum: item hortatur eos ad constantiam in fide erga ipsum, & dilectione mutua: denique consolatur eos contra odium & persecutionem mundi.

Partes capitis x i v sunt tres: Prima, (Consolatio est, quam Christus perturbationi discipulorum opponit: usque ad v.5. Secunda, (colloquium Christi continet & discipulorum ipsius de vera Dei Patris notitia: usque ad v. 12. Tertiâ, ad consolationem redit, promittens exauditionem precum, & missionem Spiritus sancti, sed inferiùr exhortatio ad seruanda præcepta ab ipso prius proposita.

Cap. x v. Sermonem eiusdem cum priore argumenti orditur; Primùm hortatur discipulos ad constantiam in fide; docens, eos per fidem sibi tanquam palmites viti, esse insitos: usque ad v. 8. Deinde hortatur eos ad studium pietatis, ac inprimis ad mutuam dilectionem: usque ad v. 18. Tertiò, consolatur eos contra odium ac persecutionem mundi, & promissionem præclaram de missione Spiritus sancti renouat; inde à v. 18. usque ad finem.

Cap. x v i. Continuat sermonem duobus superioribus capitibus institutum, & tria potissimum agit. Primùm prædicit eis mala, ipsis euentura à Iudæis, usque ad v. 5. page.notes: Italic and roman runs in the two "Partes" and "Cap. x v." paragraphs are read from the typeface and may be off at the edges. Printed chapter numbers are spaced as printed ("x i v", "x v i"). The line "Cap. x v i." reads "x v i" in the scan. The sign at the foot (an "I" with a mark) is uncertain and is given as a signature with [?]. Short-s "sancti" is read as printed, with a possible ligature. The last line ends with a printed hyphen, "con-", which continues on the next page. Show-through and the left page edge are excluded.
